ops.text: Live: launchctl disable + bootout of system/com.apple.audio.coreaudiod and system/com.apple.audiomxd in the running guest (persists across reboots via disabled.plist). Durable: commit 80ce9c43bb47 adds both labels to debloat.bluebubbles.system in machines.json (applied by cmd_debloat on every setup/reconfigure) and documents the travel-together constraint in the manifest _comment. Verified: host-side VM process 184% → 8.7%, in-guest launchd 70% → 0.5% (0.2 CPU-sec over 37s), BlueBubbles health ok (ping ok, helper_connected=True). Residual ~1Hz audiohald polls from 9 GUI/media clients are timer-paced and CPU-negligible.
